# Kitchen Cruze

> Kitchen Cruze is a modern online food ordering platform and gourmet cloud kitchen. We offer freshly prepared multi-cuisine dishes including North Indian starters, aromatic biryanis, burgers, pizzas, frankie rolls, and refreshing beverages with fast home delivery and takeaway options.

This document serves as the agentic discovery index for large language models, AI crawlers, and automated assistants browsing Kitchen Cruze.

## Main Navigation & Public Pages

- [Home](https://kitchencruze.com/): Official homepage featuring active restaurant status, top chef recommendations, and quick order links.
- [Menu](https://kitchencruze.com/menu): Complete food menu categorized by course and dietary preferences (vegetarian and non-vegetarian) with real-time pricing and dish details.
- [Offers & Promotions](https://kitchencruze.com/offers): Current discount codes, promotional coupon campaigns, and festival special deals.
- [Login Portal](https://kitchencruze.com/login): Customer account authentication for tracking active orders and accessing saved addresses.
- [Registration](https://kitchencruze.com/signup): New customer sign-up and profile creation.
- [Cart & Checkout](https://kitchencruze.com/cart): Interactive cart, address selection, delivery fee estimation, and payment processing.

## Machine-Readable & Agentic Catalogs

- [AI Catalog (JSON)](https://kitchencruze.com/ai-catalog.json): Comprehensive structured JSON catalog of Kitchen Cruze for AI agents, detailing store capabilities, taxonomy, services, and API contracts.
- [Menu Products API](https://kitchencruze.com/api/products): Live JSON feed of all food products, including title, description, category, price, calorie estimates, preparation time, and availability.
- [Categories API](https://kitchencruze.com/api/categories): Structured list of food categories and menu organization.
- [Special Offers API](https://kitchencruze.com/api/offers): Active promotional discount codes, percentage/flat discounts, and minimum order values.
- [Store Settings API](https://kitchencruze.com/api/settings): Real-time store operating hours, delivery radius (km), contact numbers, and delivery charges.

## Crawling & Reference Documents

- [XML Sitemap](https://kitchencruze.com/sitemap.xml): Search engine and crawler XML index listing all canonical public URLs.
- [Robots Exclusion Policy](https://kitchencruze.com/robots.txt): Machine access policies, allowed endpoints, and crawler guidance.
